title: Multiform
summary: MUL'TIFORM, adjective [Latin multiformis; multus, many, and forma, form.] Having many forms, shapes or appearances; as the multiform operations of the air-pump.

inlines.v: MUL'TIFORM, adjective [Latin multiformis; multus, many, and forma, form.] Having many forms, shapes or appearances; as the multiform operations of the air-pump.
